camel_example: aliyun slb ModifyLoadBalancerInstanceChargeType --region cn-hangzhou --InstanceChargeType PayByCLCU --Bandwidth 5 --LoadBalancerId 'lb-bp1b3jus5hpenznuu0000' --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --InternetChargeType paybytraffic --LoadBalancerSpec 'slb.s1.small'
description_en: Changes the metering method of a pay-as-you-go Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance
description_zh: 变更按量付费CLB实例的实例计费方式
kebab_example: aliyun slb modify-load-balancer-instance-charge-type --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --load-balancer-id lb-bp1b3jus5hpenznuu0000 --internet-charge-type paybytraffic --instance-charge-type PayByCLCU --load-balancer-spec slb.s1.small --bandwidth 5 --api-version 2014-05-15 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ModifyLoadBalancerInstanceChargeType

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en:
The metering method of Internet data transfer after the change.

Valid value: **paybytraffic**.

> - If the value of the **InstanceChargeType** parameter is set to **PayByCLCU**, only pay-by-data-transfer is supported.
>
> - When you change the metering method, the new metering method takes effect at 00:00:00 the next day.
parameters.description_zh:
变更后的公网计费方式。
仅取值**paybytraffic**：按使用流量计费。

> - 当**InstanceChargeType**参数的值为**PayByCLCU**时，只支持按使用流量计费。
> - 如果公网计费方式从按固定带宽变更为按使用流量，则所有变配会在次日00:00:00生效。

parameters.description_en:
The specification of the CLB instance.

You do not need to set this parameter. For pay-as-you-go CLB instances, you can only change the metering method from pay-by-specification to pay-by-LCU. You cannot change the metering method from pay-by-LCU to pay-by-specification.
parameters.description_zh:
传统型负载均衡实例的规格。

您无需设置该参数。目前仅支持按规格计费转按使用量计费，不支持按使用量计费转按规格计费。

parameters.description_en:
The maximum bandwidth of the Internet-facing CLB instance that is billed on a pay-by-bandwidth basis.

You do not need to set this parameter. The metering method of Internet data transfer for pay-by-LCU instances supports only pay-by-traffic.
parameters.description_zh:
按带宽计费的公网型实例的带宽峰值。
